key_findings: Review proposing vascular-targeted and collagen-targeted therapies for hypertrophic scars, depending on scar stage.
VEGF is highly expressed in pathological scars and its inhibition (anti-VEGF antibody, Endostar, triamcinolone) promotes regression in preclinical models.
